messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing GA readiness criteria for our Q2 launch. Need firm decisions on: SLA floor, docs signoff, oncall routing, monitoring burn-in, and pricing/credits. Owners + blockers?

jon: For SLA, do we want to promise latency SLAs or availability-only? Latency SLAs are risky across tenants.

maya: Prefer combined: availability + latency tiers for enterprise only. Proposed: Availability SLA 99.9% monthly; enterprise latency commitment P99 < 350ms for text-generation (vanilla models).

sanjay: 99.9% is doable but needs runbook + failover policies. For latency SLA we must define measurement window, synthetic traffic, and fallout policy. Also need warm pools for Dedicated.

lia: Support commitment: enterprise gets 24/7 oncall + 1h initial ack for SEV1; self-serve gets 24x5 with best-effort weekends. We need escalation matrix in the playbook.

raj: I'll own the docs checklist. Need exact acceptance criteria: runbook steps, playbook, API changelog, billing FAQ, and troubleshooting matrix.

jon: Action items: I'll implement latency telemetry tags and a 'sla_label' on routes (enterprise/self-serve) so metrics align. ETA EOD Thu.

maya: Can we get a short runbook snippet for common perf incidents? paste here.

sanjay: Sure — snippet:
```
SEV1 perf: 1) Check autoscale logs + GPU utilization
2) Evict or scale up pool if KV-cache overload
3) Route enterprise traffic to fallback small-model variant
4) Notify oncall via pager and start incident channel
```

lia: Add customer comms template for degraded perf: one-pager, status page blurb, and credit calc (hours downtime * pro-rata).

maya: Pricing guardrails — propose SLA credits capped at 25% monthly invoice for availability breaches, latency breaches handled as service credits only (no refunds). Thoughts?

jon: 25% cap seems OK. Need billing integration to auto-calc credits and link to invoice system. That's 2 eng tasks.

sanjay: Monitoring: require synthetic canaries hitting each region every 5m, error budget burn rate alerting, and nightly rollups for P99 trends. I can own alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline completed: 12/12 checks passed in us-west-2 — smoke, p99 latency, error-rate.

maya: Okay owners recap: Jon -> runtime telemetry & billing hooks; Sanjay -> monitoring/alerts/runbooks; Lia -> support playbook & templates; Raj -> docs signoff. Next check-in Thu 11am. Anything blocking?

lia: Need final wording on oncall rotation and SLO escalations from legal for SLA language.

maya: I'll follow up with legal. If no blockers, we target GA gating checklist: docs signed, runbook present, monitoring + canaries green 72h, billing credit automation in staging, support ops runthrough. Mark blockers in thread.
